The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `1025` (see `MailpitBuilder.SmtpPort`)
- Port: `8025` (see `MailpitBuilder.WebPort`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /readyz` to port `8025` is completed successfully.
